text: the Cochrane Database of Systematic Re- views; Issue 3. Chichester: John Wiley; 2003 (accessed 14/02/06). 9. Craig D, Birks J. Rivastigmine for vascular cognitive impair- ment. Available in the Cochrane Database of Systematic Re- views; Issue 2. Chichester: John Wiley; 2004 (accessed 14/02/06). Parkinsonism. Although acetylcholinesterase inhibitors such as rivastigmine may theoretically worsen parkinsonian symp- toms, particularly tremor, it has been tried for use in the treatment of drug-induced psychosis in patients with Parkinson’s disease (see Disturbed Behaviour, p.954). In 2 large studies,1,2 rivastig- mine was found to produce some improvement in symptoms of dementia associated with Parkinson’s disease when compared with placebo. 1. Emre M, et al. Rivastigmine for dementia associated with Par- kinson’s disease. N Engl J Med 2004; 351: 2509–18. 2. Wesnes KA, et al. Benefits of rivastigmine on attention in de- mentia associated with Parkinson disease. Neurology 2005; 65: 1654–6.
